name: What is the typical cost to repair or replace a sliding door with rot damage in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost to repair or replace a sliding door with rot damage in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to repair or replace rot damage around a sliding door in the Bay Area varies widely based on the severity of the rot, the extent of structural damage to the surrounding wall, and the type of replacement door chosen. Minor repairs might range from a few hundred to over a thousand dollars. A full replacement, including demo, new framing, installation of a standard-size door, and finish work, can range from $3,000 to $8,000 or more. High-end doors or significant structural remediation will increase costs. We provide detailed, no-obligation estimates.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair costs can be a few hundred to over a thousand, while full replacement in the Bay Area typically ranges from $3,000 to $8,000+, depending on damage and door type.
